name: Universal Remote
description: Phone-browser remote control (LAN-only) — turns any phone/tablet on the same WiFi into a remote, plus the API the Android companion app uses (quick-tap grid, channel favorite editor, trivia trigger). Works standalone; if the Party Channel plugin is also installed, channel reactions from the companion app also work.

ipc.why: receives the current channel/name from the renderer, to answer a remote's GET /state

net.why: the phone-browser remote and companion app connect to this from the LAN
